context:
MURUGANANDHAM A 
Phone : 8838274064 | Email : muru9031@gmail.com | LinkedIn | GitHub | Self Intro | Portfolio 
EDUCATION 
B.E. CSE — Sri Eshwar College of Engineering, Coimbatore | CGPA: 6.8 / 10 2025 – 2028 
Diploma in CSE — Alagappa Government Polytechnic College | 71.0% 2021 – 2024 
SSLC — CVCTV Matric Higher Secondary School | 84.0% 2020 – 2021 
INTERNSHIPS & TRAINING 
Networking Intern | BSNL (Bharat Sanchar Nigam Limited) ( 2023) 
• Gained hands-on exposure to live telecom infrastructure: telephone exchange routing, copper/fiber cable crimping, splicing, 
and hardware testing under senior engineers. 
Industrial Training | Aptitude Guru HEM (2026) 
• Completed structured training on Java Spring Boot, RESTful API design, and React.js frontend integration (Spring Boot + 
React track). 
• Gained foundational exposure to MERN Stack architecture — MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js — and full-stack 
application flow. 
PROJECTS 
Leave Management System - Tech stack : Java Spring Boot | React.js | MySQL (2026) 
• Independently built a role-based system with Admin and Employee interfaces — Spring Boot MVC backend + React.js 
frontend; fully explainable code with clear controller-service-DAO layer separation. 
• Implemented leave-approval workflow, balance tracking, and user authentication with a normalized MySQL schema built. 
Online Examination Web Application - Tech stack : Java Spring Boot | HTML5 | Tailwind CSS | JS | MySQL (2025) 
• Engineered RESTful Spring Boot controllers to manage exam data flow between a Tailwind CSS + JavaScript frontend and 
backend components. 
• Implemented student record management, question modules, and client -side form validation using Spring Boot dependency 
injection and MVC pattern. 
Bicycle Sharing Booking System - Tech stack : Java Spring Boot | HTML | CSS | JS | MySQL (2025) 
• Designed a layered Spring Boot application for a bicycle rental service with user registration, login, booking workflow, and 
real-time availability tracking. 
• Structured a normalized MySQL schema to manage user accounts, cycle inventory, and booking transaction history using the 
service-repository layer pattern. 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
SMT Department | Nokia Solutions & Networks 2024 – 2025 (1 Year, Full-Time) 
• Coordinated all SMT production stages — solder paste printing, component placement, reflow soldering, and AOI inspection 
— in Nokia's high-volume international manufacturing facility. 
• Performed root-cause analysis on PCB defect patterns via AOI machine data, upholding Nokia's global quality standards with 
cross-team coordination across QA and production units. 
Freelance Video Editor & Content Creator | Self-Employed 2023 – Present 
• Content creator on Instagram (45,000+ followers) and YouTube; delivered professional video editing for multiple clients 
using Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, managing briefs and deadlines independently. 
CODING PROFILES 
• LeetCode | 60+ Problems Solved (Arrays, Strings, Linked Lists) Profile Link 
• SkillRack | 25+ Problems Solved Profile Link 
CERTIFICATIONS 
• NPTEL: Design Thinking — A Primer (Elite / Completed) — IIT Madras / Swayam (2026) 
• Protothon National Level Hackathon — Participation Certificate (2026) 
TECHNICAL SKILLS 
Languages: Java (Core Java, OOPs Concepts), HTML, CSS, JavaScript , Sql , NoSql 
Frameworks: Java Spring Boot , React.js 
Databases: MySQL , MongoDB 
Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, VPC, Subnets, SG, RDS, DynamoDB) | Docker, Kubernetes (Conceptual — Actively Learning) 
Tools: IntelliJ IDEA, VS Code, GitHub, Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects 
Core Fundamentals: Data Structures & Algorithms, Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs).
